name: FOLLOW MY VOICE
description: Acquire a Drone, OR, acquire 1 Fear for every drone in your play area.

name: GIVE IN
description: Bury a card in your discard pile, acquire a Drone.

name: MARCHING ORDERS
description: Draw three cards, discard two.

name: HORDE
description: Acquire a Drone, OR, bury all Drones in your play area and inflict 2 suspicion for each.

name: SCOUT
description: Acquire a Drone, OR, draw a card for every Drone in your play area.

name: DRONE
description: Draw a card.

name: REWIRE
description: Draw two cards, discard a card.

name: SLAVES FOR CHEAP
description: Acquire a Drone.

name: UFO
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: CONSPIRACY THEORIST
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: POWER WORD: STRENGTH
description: Play this card after any die roll, before the effect happens. Ignore the current roll's result, and roll the die again.

name: THE GREAT AND POWERFUL
description: Roll the die. If 5 or more, acquire 6 Fear. Otherwise, that sucks.

name: POWER WORD: CURSE
description: Name a number, roll the die. If you roll lower, self-inflict the named amount of suspicion. Otherwise, inflict the named amount.

name: POWER WORD: MISSILE
description: Roll the Die. If 3 or more, inflict 4 suspicion. Otherwise, self-inflict 3 suspicion.

name: INCESSANT CHANTING
description: Roll the die until the sum of the rolls is higher than the current suspicion meter. Draw a card for each roll you did.

name: ARCANE WHISPERS
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: HALLUCINATIONS
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: LOVELAND ALWAYS WINS
description: The next time you're tasked with rolling the dice this turn, roll the dice twice, and use the higher result as the result of your roll.

name: TOIL AND TROUBLE
description: Roll the die. Acquire Fear equal to half the roll's value, rounded up.

name: INTRUDER
description: Reveal the top card of the main deck, copy its effect, place it at the bottom of the deck.

name: A TERRIBLE OMEN
description: Acquire a card that costs 4 or less.

name: POKER HAND TIME
description: If 4+ cards in the town have the same cost, place them on the bottom of the main deck, and inflict suspicion equal to the amount of cards.

name: PLUCK FROM THE STREETS
description: Place a card from the graveyard on either the top or bottom of the main deck.

name: FOLLOW THE LIGHT
description: When this card is acquired, bury this card, and acquire the top 3 cards of the main deck.

name: BLINDING LIGHT
description: Bury a town card. You may continue to bury cards, as long as each successive card costs 1 Fear more than the previous. Inflict 1 suspicion for each card buried this way.

name: WATCH THE GATES
description: Look at the top 4 cards of the main deck. You may return them to the top or bottom of the deck in any order.

name: EYES IN THE DARK
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: TRICK OF THE LIGHT
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: SCOUT PREY
description: Copy the effect of a town card whose cost is 3 or less.

name: HESITANT NEW FACES
description: Acquire 1 Fear. You may bury a card from your hand to acquire 1 Fear.

name: PATROL ROUND
description: Draw two cards, discard two cards.

name: INNOCENT CHILD
description: Acquire 1 Fear. If buried, inflict 2 suspicion.

name: CLOSE YOUR BLINDS
description: Bury this card, draw two cards.

name: INFIGHTING
description: Draw a card. You may discard it to draw another.

name: NEGATIVITY BIAS
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion. If you already inflicted this turn, inflict 1 more.

name: DOOMSAYER
description: Acquire 2 Fear.

name: MAKING A STATEMENT
description: Discard a card to acquire 3 Fear.

name: SCOPOPHOBIA
description: Perform your character's ability without paying the suspicion cost.

name: HERD MENTALITY
description: Copy the effect of a card in your play area.

name: MASKED MEN
description: Inflict 2 Suspicion.

name: PITCHFORKS AND TORCHES
description: For every two cards you've played this turn, inflict suspicion.

name: REVEL IN INFAMY
description: If the suspicion meter is aimed at you, acquire fear equal to the meter's value. Else, inflict 2 suspicion.

name: MASSACRE
description: Inflict 3 Suspicion. You may bury up to 2 cards in your discard pile.

name: AS IT WAS WRITTEN
description: Inflict 2 suspicion. Place a card from your discard pile in your hand.

name: BLIND ADRENALINE
description: Draw three cards.

name: BIG MONEY
description: Acquire a town card for free, place it at the top of your deck.

name: HYSTERIA
description: Inflict 4 suspicion.

name: INSATIABLE HUNGER
description: Acquire 1 Fear. Bury a card in your hand or discard pile.

name: DEAD WEIGHT
description: When this card is acquired, place it in opponent's discard pile. Does nothing.

name: ERASE, REPLACE
description: Copy the effect of a card in your play area, then bury it.

name: BACK FOR SECONDS
description: Choose a card in the Graveyard. Copy its effect, then place it at the bottom of the main deck.

name: GRAVEROBBING
description: Acquire 2 Fear. This turn you may buy a card from the graveyard as if it were a town card.

name: CAUTIONARY TALES
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: PLANTED EVIDENCE
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: AFTERTASTE
description: Copy the effect of a random card in the graveyard.

name: OLD HABITS
description: Gain 1 Fear. If this card is buried, draw two cards.
